title: Platform Method Overview
purpose: Organize MOF screening, evidence boundaries, and module routing as a research prototype.
purposeZh: 将 MOF 筛选、证据边界和模块入口组织为研究原型平台。
limitations: Platform overview does not validate any material performance.
limitationsZh: 平台总览不验证任何材料性能。

title: Sustainability-oriented Screening
purpose: Expose early sustainability signals alongside candidate feasibility assumptions.
purposeZh: 将早期可持续性信号与候选可行性假设并列展示。
limitations: EcoScreen is not a full ISO LCA or validated cost model.
limitationsZh: EcoScreen 不是完整 ISO LCA 或已验证成本模型。

title: Candidate Performance Priority
purpose: Combine uptake, selectivity, confidence, and descriptor availability into early-stage decision support.
purposeZh: 将吸附量、选择性、置信度和描述符可用性组合为早期决策支持。
limitations: Performance priority is not a replacement for measured isotherms, mixture selectivity, or validation experiments.
limitationsZh: 性能优先级不能替代实测等温线、混合气选择性或验证实验。

title: Condition-aware Gas Separation Records
titleZh: 条件化气体分离数据记录
purpose: Curate gas separation selectivity, uptake, breakthrough, and provenance records with explicit experimental or literature conditions.
purposeZh: 在明确实验或文献条件下整理气体分离选择性、吸附量、穿透容量与字段级来源。
limitations: Current limitation: curated literature data, not online IAST/GCMC. Directly comparable only if gas system, feed ratio, temperature, pressure, and method are all identical.
limitationsZh: 当前限制：展示 curated literature data，不是在线 IAST/GCMC。只有气体体系、气体比例、温度、压力、方法都一致时，才视为可直接比较。

title: Catalytic Pathway Evidence Workspace
purpose: Compare catalytic pathway evidence, reaction fingerprints, MOF rationale, and validation roadmap items without treating hypotheses as proof.
purposeZh: 比较催化路径证据、反应指纹、MOF 依据和验证路线，但不把假设当作证明。
limitations: Organic acid conversion is a prioritized sub-workspace within Catalysis Lab, not the full scope of catalysis.
limitationsZh: 有机酸转化是 Catalysis Lab 中优先展示的子工作台，但不是催化模块的全部范围。

title: Rule-based and Evidence-weighted Organic Acid Priority Logic
titleZh: 规则驱动与证据加权的有机酸优先级逻辑
purpose: Explain candidate MOF / catalyst priority across organic-acid pathways using pathway fit, descriptors, evidence support, risk penalty, and validation gaps.
purposeZh: 用路径适配、描述符、证据支持、风险惩罚和验证缺口解释候选 MOF / catalyst 在有机酸路径下的优先级。
limitations: Organic Acid priority matrix is a decision-support view, not an experimentally validated ranking. Algorithm Trace Explorer explains rule and evidence contributions. It does not prove mechanistic causality.
limitationsZh: 有机酸候选物优先级矩阵是决策支持视图，不是已经实验验证的真实排名。Algorithm Trace Explorer 用于解释规则和证据对优先级的贡献，不证明真实机理因果关系。

title: Descriptor and Source-record Curation
titleZh: 描述符与来源记录整理
purpose: Separate common MOF display names, source record IDs, field values, and provenance status.
purposeZh: 区分 MOF 常用名、来源记录 ID、字段数值和来源整理状态。
limitations: Database records are not scientific conclusions until task-specific evidence is verified.
limitationsZh: 数据库记录在完成任务相关证据验证前，不等同于科研结论。
